premises.text: Mainstream nav apps precompute routes assuming static traffic during a drive, so they miss the true fastest path and reroute frequently
premises.evidence_span: They assume traffic doesn't change during the course of your drive

premises.text: Time-dependent routing on minute-level loop-detector and similar data computes road costs based on when a driver will actually reach each turn
premises.evidence_span: time-dependent routing, where the cost of each stretch of road is calculated based on when you're actually expected to reach each turn

premises.text: Businesses that move people or goods lack embeddable real-time turn-by-turn navigation inside their own apps, forcing costly app-switching or build-your-own navigation
premises.evidence_span: embeddable navigation simply doesn't exist today

premises.text: A Navigation SDK lets any company embed real-time turn-by-turn navigation with a short integration
premises.evidence_span: any company can embed real-time, turn-by-turn navigation directly into their existing apps

value.text: Companies get true real-time fastest routes embedded in their own apps for moving people and things
value.evidence_span: embed real-time, turn-by-turn navigation directly into their existing apps

causal_links.evidence_span: these apps are leaving a lot on the table
